_doc: Textured floors/ceilings (Modernization): dominant wall code of an
area -> [ceiling texture, floor texture]. Chosen by eye from the
contact sheet after metric filtering (readability, tiling, baked
lighting gradient); WALL033 was rejected as a floor because it is
the German-text brick. Eric holds veto authority over every pair -
regenerate the verdict rooms after editing. Codes are Wolf plane-0
wall codes; dominance = wall faces adjacent to the area's floor
(immune to decorative one-offs). fallback covers the long tail
(top 10 walls cover ~93% of the 867 WL6 areas).
